messages.body_plain:
Dear both,

I am sorry for my delayed reply. Thank you a lot for your quick responses!

Unfortunately, we still encountered the same issue. Is it possible to stop the restart in quick succession? Thank you for your help in advance.

Best regards,
Ivy

On Monday, 27 December 2021 at 13:18:40 UTC+1 robbie...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hi both,
>
> The problem seems to be down to a restart in quick succession causing issues with the cached results downloading:
> <simpleError in download.file.wcheck(url, destdir = folderpath, ...): Unable to read url: http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/flycircuit/allbyallblastcanon_f9dc90ce5b2ffb74af37db1e3a2cb35b.desc and no cached file exists!>
>
> I've restarted the server and am hopeful it should resolve the issue; though it will take approx 50 mins to redownload all the data before normal service resumes.
>
> Thanks,
>
> Rob
>
> On Mon, 27 Dec 2021 at 10:11, Gregory Jefferis <jeff...@gmail.com> wrote:
> > Dear Ivy, Thanks for your message and sorry that you’re having trouble. That server is now run by Rob Court at VFB but the timing is unfortunate as he is currently taking a well-earned Christmas break. I’m sure he have it back up and running when he is back in the office. Best, Greg Jefferis.
